text:
mia: Quick sync — Sundial Systems case draft is done but legal needs the exact quote text and a release email before we publish. Target webinar + publish window two weeks out.
ben: Paste the draft link pls. I'll prep the landing and map SF campaign.
ben: https://docs.google.com/sundial-case-draft (copy at bottom)
olga: Design needs svg logo, 1 hero screenshot, and a headshot. Also prefer a neutral hero title pre-approval: 'Inference improvements at scale'.
tom: Ops routing: set hidden field campaign=sundial_case, route leads to NA_AE, assign follow-ups to @alex. Also map SF campaign SUND-2026.
rachel: Legal redlines: provide verbatim quote; change informal approximations to 'approximately' per style; include explicit release phrase: "Sundial Systems grants Redwood permission to publish the quote, logo, and translated versions on or after the agreed publish date." Need that in an approval email. No raw ARR/MRR allowed unless anonymized.
mia: Proposed quote from Sundial VP Eng (verbatim they sent):
```
"Redwood decreased our p99 latency by ~61% and lowered per-token cost by nearly 50%, which accelerated our release cadence."
```
rachel: Redline suggestion — change `~61%` -> `approximately 61%`; `nearly 50%` -> `approximately 50%`. Also ask them to confirm recording permission for the webinar video clip.
ben: I'll set the landing page and hidden field. When we have legal clearance, I'll turn on the nurture sequence (3 emails).
olga: I'll design the hero slide generically and provide social tile variations. I'll swap logos post-approval. Need assets by EOD Mon to hit the timeline.
mia: I just emailed Sundial comms asking for: 1) exact publish date, 2) the approval email with the release text and recording permission, 3) svg logo + headshot, 4) confirmation we won't use raw revenue.
alex: Routing confirmed — I'll pick up demo leads for NA West. Please tag me on the landing form so I get notified.
rachel: Once the approval email arrives with the publish date, paste it here and I'll mark legal sign-off. If the email arrives by Mon EOD, legal can clear for the planned publish. :thumbsup:
calendar-bot: Event created — "Sundial: customer interview" Tue 09:30 PT — invites sent to mia,ben,olga,tom,alex
olga: Recording plan confirmed. I'll capture a 10s CTO soundbite and a frame grab for the one-pager.
mia: Updated (post-redline) quote we'll ask Sundial to approve verbatim:
```
"Redwood reduced our p99 latency by approximately 61% and reduced per-token costs by approximately 50%, which accelerated our release cadence." — Sundial VP Eng
```
rachel: That wording aligns with legal. Two asks for the email: 1) include the verbatim quote above, 2) include the release sentence with publish date and permission for translations/video.
ben: I'll map SF campaign and set `utm_campaign=sundial_case` on the landing. Nurture will start 3 days before webinar pending legal.
mia: Final checklist: 1) Approval email with publish date & release text (mia) 2) Legal sign-off (rachel) 3) Assets: svg logo, headshot, screenshot (sundial -> shared/marketing/sundial) (olga) 4) Slides + one-pager + social pack (olga) 5) Landing page + lead routing -> @alex (ben) 6) Recording & 10s soundbite (olga/tom) 7) SF campaign mapping (ben). Target publish: two business days after webinar.
alex: I'll be on deck for demos & will set a Slack alert when someone signs up.
mia: Thanks all — will update this thread when Sundial replies. :pray:
